summary: editable-contracts 0.0.20 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that runs on every install. setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/, unzips it into a tmpdir, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated single-line bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using string-array shuffle (WV8StW/n7gIxM), custom-charset decoder (hc1jfK9), and hex-only identifiers, deliberately shaped to require the freshly downloaded Bun runtime and to bypass Node-based inspection. The library's declared main dist/editable-contracts.js (a small MobX helper) never references math_init.js — the payload executes only through the preinstall+Bun path. The install-time chain is grafted onto an otherwise small legitimate library, consistent with a trojanized/hijacked publish of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
